title: Mini Honey Infused Hair Perfume in Vanilla Glaze
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Clean at Sephora✓ All Hair Types✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Increases Shine✓ Hydrating
What it is: A delicate hair perfume, enriched with Mirsalehi honey, formulated to refresh and scent the hair with a limited-edition scent, Vanilla Glaze.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Dryness
- Shine

Key Benefits:
- Scents hair with Vanilla Graze fragrance
- Refreshes and nourishes
- Adds instant shine

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy hair.
- Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy shine.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray, shake, and shine.
-Divide hair into sections and spray evenly from an arm’s length distance throughout the hair. -Give your hair a flip to diffuse the irresistible Vanilla Glaze scent.
-Hair is hydrated, scented, and has a glossy shine.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy hair.
-Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy shine.

Alcohol Denat., Aqua (Water, Eau), Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Sodium Benzotriazolyl Butylphenol Sulfonate, Tris(Tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) Citrate, Acetyl Cedrene**, Coumarin**, Rose Ketones**, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes**, Vanillin**, CI 19140 (Yellow 5), CI 14700 (Red 4).
